correctness.rationale: Precisely q² vertices and q²(q-1) labeled edges encode all a!=c triples. Adjacency A(F)=1(F1)^T-F^T is decomposed into symmetric and alternating doubly centered matrices, the all-ones line, and q-1 explicit 2x2 blocks. These contribute exactly the displayed characteristic polynomial. The directed Laplacian has one zero eigenvalue and row/column sum zero, so its common cofactor is the product of its nonzero eigenvalues divided by q². This produces the positive rooted-tree count and strong connectivity; BEST with a distinguished edge yields the exact rotation-class product with no extra factor. For q=2 the graph is a directed 4-cycle. The standalone integer-minor checks q=2..6 and exhaustive q=2,3 circuit enumeration independently agree. Infinite correctness rests on proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: A canonical, non-arbitrary forbidden-factor language is obtained by removing every ordinary 3-letter palindrome, leaving all other q³-q² triples. An Eulerian universal cycle is the shortest possible once-only cyclic test string for precisely this language. Existence alone does not determine how many such strings exist, and the exact count together with the full spectral decomposition is a structural all-alphabet invariant, not an isolated small numeric improvement or known de Bruijn count with parameters relabeled. The paper-sized generalization is not claimed. The result is restricted to ordinary length-three palindrome exclusion and labeled rotation classes.
